text: 'Give us an honest answer' isn't a requirement yet -- it's an intention. This video turns it into something you can actually test.
REQ-1: every quantum result must be checked against a provably exact classical baseline on the identical problem instance.
REQ-2: the study must be able to report 'quantum didn't help' as a legitimate finding, not a failure.
Dr. Amara Osei checks the methodology. Felix Nakamura builds the exact classical answer the quantum result is measured against.
Next: scoping V1 -- one bounded portfolio problem, honestly benchmarked.
